proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s₁ s₂ T h1 h2
  have e1 : dist T s₁.center = s₁.radius := h1
  have e2 : dist T s₂.center = s₂.radius := h2
  have t1 := dist_triangle_left s₁.center s₂.center T
  have t2 := dist_triangle T s₁.center s₂.center
  have t3 := dist_triangle T s₂.center s₁.center
  rw [dist_comm s₂.center s₁.center] at t3
  rw [e1, e2] at t1 t2 t3
  refine ⟨abs_sub_le_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, t1⟩
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s₁ s₂ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (T : P), T ∈ s₁ → T ∈ s₂ → |s₁.radius - s₂.radius| ≤ dist s₁.center s₂.center ∧ dist s₁.center s₂.center ≤ s₁.radius + s₂.radius
